question: Can picks or betting recommendations be published to people in the Netherlands?
current_answer_or_knowledge: Not determined. Art. 1 of the Wet op de kansspelen prohibits promoting participation in unlicensed gambling (see S12). Ksa states that without a licence an operator may not advertise at all, and that online sports betting needs an Art. 31a licence (S10, S11). This is not legal advice. No picks are published.
missing_information: Dutch counsel opinion on whether picks, tips or analysis count as promotion
discovery_step: Obtain a written legal opinion. Until then, picks.html publishes blank cells and no picks
